_desc: ENRICHED TEAM SIM (user 2026-07-19): ONE team with MIXED membership — homed ends XH1@S1/XH2@S3 (dual: static registration + team plane) bridged by an OFF-GRID middle chain XO3-XO4-XO5 (4 team hops end-to-end) — plus co-located team Y {YO1,YO2} and statics S1-S3. NEW COVERAGE vs s22-s27: (1) MULTI-HOP team CHANNEL propagation (s22 proved 1-hop only) in BOTH origin directions (homed-origin + off-grid-origin); (2) mixed-membership team DMs (by team id homed->off-grid, by hash off-grid->homed); (3) leaf-vs-team channel interplay at DUAL members (a dual member receives BOTH planes) + DOCUMENTED current behavior: an off-grid mobile configured with the leaf's layer_id ingests leaf broadcasts (XO4 assert — RF-local broadcast; if that's undesired it's a design change, not a bug); (4) ★ TEAM-SURVIVES-HOME-DEATH: S1 dies @700k, XH1's post-death team post must still cross the chain (the team plane is independent of home-registration state); (5) digest-gate + containment regression in a RICHER topology (Y + statics hear team-X floods directly; zero ingest, zero static pulls). Wrapper note: team DMs by HASH (no by-id wrapper verb exists; by-id -t is native-covered). Channel asserts key on UNIQUE channel_id per message (relayed channel_msg_received emits carry no payload). Fake hashes (channels are cleartext; encrypted team DMs covered by s22). CANDIDATE for the mandatory suite once green + anchored. ★ S7 EXTENSION (user-ratified): XO4 leaf assert FLIPPED to not-receive (off-grid ≠ leaf member; homed XH1 stays MUST-receive); + send-side coverage ch6 (plain send_channel from a homed mobile = GLOBAL, delegated via home, team skipped) + ch7 (both-mode). Wrapper verbs send_channel_g/_b are PLACEHOLDERS — the coder names the real console flags (-t/-g) + adds the wrapper verbs. QA fix 2026-07-19: XO4->S2 link made ONE-WAY (S2 hears XO4 for containment; XO4 stays genuinely OFF-GRID) + S2 count 1->3 (delegated globals land). KNOWN BLOCKER F-SF-1: the OFFER data_sf_bitmap is 1 byte (frame_codec.cpp:696, mask node_join.cpp:356) -> SF>=8 truncated -> registered members adopt SF7-only vs off-grid SF7/9 -> mixed-chain flood SF mismatches block the remaining multi-hop asserts until the SF-bitmap slice lands.

★ F-TR-1 (2026-07-20): a HOMED member DMs its off-grid teammate BY HASH on the EXPLICIT TEAM plane (-t; plain would delegate to the home = the static universe, correct-but-unresolvable post-HARD-SPLIT)

off-grid->homed team DM by hash, 2 team hops (XO4-XO5-XH2; ≥3-hop team-hash is the DOCUMENTED s23 attenuation boundary, not asserted) [moved 620k->660k 2026-07-20: at 620k both team H floods collide at XO4 (h2o forward lands mid-o2h TX burst) - pure airtime contention, both mechanisms proven independently]. ★ PLANE 2026-07-28 (§sim-plane-parity): the trailing `-t` is now REQUIRED for a team-plane DM. The sim's plain DM verbs used to leave Command.u.send.plane at 0 (AUTO); they now emit GLOBAL, mirroring lib/console/console_parse.cpp:259 (`team ? TEAM : GLOBAL`), the ONLY plane assignment on real firmware. Without `-t` this send is GLOBAL, and §6.4/§18 then force the STATIC _rt (node_routing.cpp:22) and skip the team hash-locate cascade (node_hashlocate.cpp:1021) — exactly what metal does. This was the ONE plain team DM left in s28 while its h2o sibling above already carried `-t`; the asymmetry was an oversight. ⚠ MEASURED: adding `-t` here is PROTOCOL-IDENTICAL — not one radio/telemetry event moves; the only stream delta is the 1 cmd_reply line that echoes the command text (3552 events unchanged, 2 differing lines). The reason: an off-grid member with an id_bind miss reaches the plane-INDEPENDENT off-grid team park at node_hashlocate.cpp:1098, which forces Plane::TEAM either way — so GLOBAL and TEAM take the same path here. ⚠ That fallback is ALSO why a GLOBAL send by an off-grid team member still resolves on the team plane, which is arguably a §6.4 hard-split residual; REPORTED, not changed by this slice.
